summary.creative_priority: Useful exact-demand folded descent and recoverable detour; do not count the two canonical controls as two Modules or new gameplay families.

visual_review.method: Actually viewed two chronological 12-tile native MP4 contact sheets and one full-resolution frame from each. These are AI visual observations, not human play or approval.
visual_review.normal_observation: The actor crosses the initially solid horizontal gate, shoots to withdraw the floor, falls onto M, moves to the right side of the access bell, shoots again to reopen the lateral gate, then jumps across to the visible reward shore.
visual_review.recovery_observation: After the same withdrawal the actor moves left past M, lands on the retained lower stair, jumps and uses an air shot to rise back onto M, then resumes the ordinary access-bell route to the same chest.
visual_review.visible_decision: The useful decisions are when and where to withdraw the actual support, how to land on M or use the lower recovery stage, and where to stand for the existing side-restricted receiver. This is a sequential two-port route, not a multi-port choice junction.
visual_review.readability_risk: Whole-world framing makes the two small bells and their labels subtle. The lower bell is labelled RETURN / RIGHT SIDE by the original Cell even though this outbound route uses it. The x≥588 eligibility boundary is not itself drawn; a player can plausibly hit it from the left without understanding why the hit is rejected. Visible chest, gate A/B labels and linking lines help. This is an AI concern, not observed human confusion.
visual_review.boredom_risk: Normal play has approach, two grounded shots, a fall and a final jump. The recovery introduces a clearer movement problem but must not become mandatory. Suitable as a small airlock beat; insufficient novelty for a new family or 3/4-port representative.

mechanism_and_resources.resource_correction: Both normal shots are grounded; raw gun remains 1 after firing because original ground recovery applies. M is a real supported landing but is not demonstrated as the unique necessary refill for the normal control. In recovery, the frame-186 airborne shot actually consumes gun to 0, and frame-220 M landing restores gun to 1. Do not sell the normal route as a mandatory scarce-air-ammo reset.
mechanism_and_resources.withdraw_timing: Normal and recovery share grounded bridge support frames 66–110; the first shot is frame106 and real switch to open A is110. The 12-frame purpose window is verified by actual bridge-supported frames, not merely center-point proximity.
mechanism_and_resources.pair_invariant: All inspected full raw frames preserve complementary open/closed flags, collision layers and disabled shapes through the existing checked_purpose. Normal/recovery have no blocked switch. The separate final-rule component fixture records one real body-blocked close, with no successful switch; it is not an enrolled Module or a universal anti-pinch proof.

counter_policy_audit.interpretation: Five same-goal variants retain the ordinary two-swap chain for the normal case. The recovery case includes those five plus the explicit ordinary-supported-M alternative; all six correctly fail the special missed-M witness while passing ordinary purpose and are accepted. Players need not intentionally miss M. The independent recovery canonical must still pass its stricter actual stair/air-shot/refill checks.
counter_policy_audit.no_counter_name_exemption: module_counter_policy recomputes ordinary two-swap purpose over each actual raw result. Its successful ordinary route branch does not depend on counterexample names. The structural policy can also preserve higher-action or actual staged lower-recovery solutions; no such further successful same-goal solution appeared in these 50 cases.
counter_policy_audit.limits: Finite ordinary-jump, omitted-shot, shore pre-opening, timing, receiver-miss and lower-climb controls did not invalidate this design. This is not a proof that all bypasses are absent.

quality_scope.native_movies: Both strict comparisons failed; each has exactly45 support_id differences. Independent comparison of all33 shared frame fields reproduces the original exhaustive differences exactly. No comparator relaxation or new replay.
quality_scope.reverse: Final-rule same-world A→B→A attempt obtains10 coins and later fails out_of_bounds at1275 frames; not a reverse certificate or a proof of impossibility. Earlier rule attempt never obtained the reward.

recommendations.retain: Keep for west-high/east-low exact-demand retrieval as one C02 spatial adaptation with two scoped witnesses.
recommendations.human_first_view: View normal and recovery together to judge the difference between a straightforward airlock and a recoverable movement detour. Keep review-only labels visible.
recommendations.future: If presentation is revised, clarify outbound use and allowed shooting side of the access bell, and bind the new presentation separately. Additional interfaces or reverse/recovery guarantees require their own evidence.

offline_audit_method.raw: For each of the 19 full physics inputs, gzip-decompress the paired output, assert case id/order/count, recompute checked_purpose(module), checked_purpose(rules), external_outcome and custom classify with corresponding clean baseline. Assert each of50 decisions exactly equals persisted counter_classification. Select actual bridge support, shot origins, switches, support landings, gun states and reward endpoint from stored frames.
offline_audit_method.probes: Read each listed probe input/output pair directly, count cases and nonempty frames, hash compressed and raw bytes; do not sum summaries or source_snapshot copies.
offline_audit_method.native: Compare all shared frame keys of each native trace against matched clean-screen raw using exact Python equality. Assert the complete difference list equals the original exhaustive audit, including support_id failures.
